title: The function machine

lessons.title: Feed the input
lessons.question: How does a function turn an input into an output, step by step?
lessons.text: Watch the value tokens enter the hopper x.
lessons.explain: x stands in for whatever data the call passes.
lessons.opens: What happens to the missing values?

lessons.title: The sieve
lessons.question: What happens to the missing values?
lessons.text: Watch the red NA tokens at the sieve.
lessons.explain: x[!is.na(x)] keeps only the present values, so n counts 58 of 62 for the sleep data.

lessons.title: The output
lessons.question: What does the dial compute?
lessons.text: Follow the tokens through the dial to the tray.
lessons.explain: sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) is the last line of the body, so it is the output: 0.605 for the sleep data.
lessons.opens: Which functions will you need in a whole analysis, and in what order?
